text: {"lessons":["I sold several positions at a gain, but a gain by itself does not mean it is time to sell; I should follow a consistent plan and consider each position’s role and risk.","My account value rose and fell modestly while I mostly held. Since past price changes do not predict future ones, I should not trade just to react to these fluctuations.","When I review a position, I should judge its prospects and risk objectively—not let the pain of realizing a loss or the satisfaction of locking in a gain dictate my decision."]}
